prompt: Granola bars cost $\$0.65$ each. With $\$5.20$ of allowance money, how many granola bars can you buy?
hint: You are asking how many $\$0.65$ groups fit inside $\$5.20$ — that is division.

hints.text: You are asking how many $\$0.65$ groups fit inside $\$5.20$ — that is division.
Multiply both numbers by $100$ to work in cents: $520 \div 65$.

explanation: Working in cents keeps it whole: $520$ cents $\div$ $65$ cents.
$65 \times 8 = 520$, so exactly $8$ bars fit with nothing left over.

alternativeExplanations.title: Estimate first
steps: $\$0.65$ is close to $\$0.50$, and $\$5.20 \div \$0.50$ would be about $10$.
